{{Top|leg}}
'''Mag-pellets''' were projectiles that could be fired in multitudes at a target. Each mag-pellet had a [[Magnet/Legends|magnetic]] charge that caused them to be fired at a great velocity from a magnetic pulse weapon, such as a [[Verpine shatter gun]]. The magnetic charge could also induce the mag-pellets to travel more quickly to their destination if there was any metal components on [[Armor/Legends|armor]] or towards the [[Hull/Legends|hull]] of a [[Starship/Legends|starship]].
